title: Stop six event RPCs scanning pg_timezone_names on every call (/discover statement timeouts)

source.ref: Meta scan 2026-11-02 (audits/meta-scan-2026-11-02.md), live EXPLAIN ANALYZE plus Vercel runtime errors

detail: public_events(200) took 537 ms in production against 2.7 ms with the zone list fixed. Its materialized CTE reads pg_catalog.pg_timezone_names (1,196 rows, about 80 ms alone) per call; density_by_city, event_calendar_feed, public_calendar_feed, public_organizer_events and space_public_calendar_feed do the same. Vercel runtime errors: 17 'canceling statement due to statement timeout' on /discover/events, circles, cities, topics since 2026-09-14. Expected lift: /discover and the home live data drop about 500 ms of database time per uncached request and the timeouts stop.

verify.evidence: Probe passes on this branch; migration applied to production and public_events(200) re-measured.
